description: Nigeria tourist eVisa from the UK: single entry, valid for 30 to 90 days and decided in about 48 hours. Who needs one, the documents and how we apply.
h1: Nigeria tourist eVisa from the UK
intro: Planning a holiday or a visit to family or friends in Nigeria? This page explains the Nigeria tourist eVisa, who needs one and what to prepare. We check the rules for your passport and apply for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday, sightseeing or to visit family or friends
You won’t work or do business during your visit
You have a return ticket and enough money for your stay
documents: Passport photo page scan, valid for at least 6 months
Hotel booking, or an invitation from the people you’re visiting

sections.heading: Do you need a Nigeria tourist eVisa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Nigeria. Since May 2025, short visits such as tourism, business and visiting family can be applied for online as a Nigeria eVisa, with decisions usually within 48 hours.

sections.heading: eVisa or regular visa?
sections.text: The Nigeria eVisa is single entry, valid for between 30 and 90 days depending on the type, and can't be extended. If you need a longer stay or several trips, apply for the regular [Nigeria tourist visa](/nigeria-tourist-visa-uk/) instead.

sections.heading: What a Nigeria tourist eVisa covers
sections.text: A Nigeria tourist eVisa is for holidays, sightseeing and visiting family or friends in Nigeria. It doesn't cover business meetings or paid work. If you're travelling for business, see our [Nigeria business visa](/nigeria-business-evisa-uk/) page.

sections.heading: UK residents on other passports
sections.text: UK residents on other passports apply the same way unless their nationality is exempt, such as ECOWAS countries. Longer stays and work need a different visa.

sections.heading: Nigeria tourist eVisa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Nigeria tourist eVisa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Nigeria.

faqs.q: Can I visit family on a Nigeria tourist eVisa?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting family or friends is covered by the Nigeria tourist eVisa.

faqs.q: Can I work in Nigeria on a Nigeria tourist eVisa?
faqs.a: No. Working needs a work visa or permit. Contact us and we’ll explain the options.

faqs.q: How long does a Nigeria tourist eVisa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
